page.layout: Running head at top (IN LEGES ATTICAS.), page number 463 top right. Running text in one block. Two law quotations, each set as parallel columns: a left column of Greek capitals and a narrow right column of italic Latin translation, read left column first. Greek verse lines in italic at the top and mid-page. No margin notes.

page.notes: Greek polytonic verse lines and several Greek words in the italic passages are read from a small, blurred scan; these are approximate and marked [?] where uncertain, and the first verse line and the line "ὃ μόνοι φιλεῖν" are especially doubtful. The Greek Eunuchus quotations ending in "ἔχων" and "ψαύ-σαντα" are doubtful. The printed "AABH" and "EAN" are Greek capitals ΛΑΒΗ and ΕΑΝ. The line "Ἀτρείδαι." is a separate line in the printed text. A stain on the left margin near the middle of the page and a mark at the right edge are not printed text and are left out.
